gold.user: As a user, I want to retrieve a list of all SIP domains associated with my Twilio account so that I can manage my SIP configurations effectively.
gold.ideal: The response should include an array of SIP domain objects, each containing properties such as Sid, FriendlyName, and Status.

gold.user: As a user, I want to create a new SIP domain for my Twilio account so that I can enable SIP communication for my applications.
gold.ideal: The response should return the newly created SIP domain object with its Sid, FriendlyName, and Status.

gold.user: As a user, I want to fetch the details of a specific SIP domain using its Sid so that I can review its configuration.
gold.ideal: The response should include the SIP domain object with all relevant details such as FriendlyName, VoiceUrl, and Status.

gold.user: As a user, I want to update the settings of an existing SIP domain so that I can modify its configuration as needed.
gold.ideal: The response should return the updated SIP domain object reflecting the changes made.

gold.user: As a user, I want to delete a specific SIP domain from my Twilio account so that I can remove unused or outdated configurations.
gold.ideal: The response should confirm the deletion of the SIP domain, ideally returning a success message.
